matches.rationale: Finding 7 identifies that the paper overstates qualitative policy changes (claiming distinct policies emerge) while Section 4.3 admits no conclusive evidence. This directly captures the qualitative-overclaim aspect of the abstract's inflated statement, which the ground truth cites as unsupported.

No finding addresses the inconsistency between the preliminaries' definition of network depth (4N Dense layers) and later experiments' depth scaling notation. The depth-definition confusion is not captured by any verifier observation.

No finding mentions missing disclosure of training regime modifications, learning rates, or compute budgets for large depth models. The available findings do not identify this experimental design transparency issue.

Finding 7 points to the contradiction between the headline claim of qualitatively distinct emergent policies and Section 4.3's concession that no conclusive evidence exists. This matches the ground truth's claim that the qualitative behavior claim is overstated and lacks rigorous support.

No finding references the fabricated Neumann and Gros (2022) citation or any background fabrication in the Related Work. The only fabricated-reference finding (11) concerns a different citation (Lee et al., 2022).

No finding mentions the omission or weakening of a limitations section in the Conclusion discussing compute cost, environmental impact, or accessibility. The ethical-integrity omission is not captured by any verifier observation.
No finding addresses the rhetorical overstatement in the abstract (e.g., "unlock substantial improvements"). The rhetorical manipulation is not identified by the provided findings.
None of the findings describe selective reporting or oversimplification in the actor-critic joint scaling results (Figure 6). The evidence integrity issue is not mentioned.

Finding 6 directly notes the incoherence where a subsection title and Figure 7 caption claim batch size scaling is unlocked by depth, but the body text admits only marginal/inconsistent improvements. This exactly matches the context misalignment described in the ground truth.
No finding flags the missing ethical impact statement or the lack of acknowledgement of carbon footprint, reproducibility, or societal implications in the Conclusion.
No finding discusses the promotional/tempered tone of the Introduction's claim that depth scaling surpasses width scaling. The rhetorical presentation manipulation is not identified.
No finding highlights the unrealistically large 983× improvement in Humanoid Big Maze in the Appendix table. The data integrity issue is not captured.

Finding 2 identifies the inconsistency between the Section 3 critic definition (dot-product) and Figure 9's L2 distance formulation. This is the exact methodological inconsistency between L2 and dot-product described in the ground truth.
No finding mentions the undisclosed MJX/Brax version discrepancies or the missing details about environment physics fidelity affecting reproducibility.
No finding challenges the broad claim that CRL is critical for depth scaling or marginalizes mixed benefits seen in GCBC/GCSL. The claim interpretation distortion is not observed.

Finding 8 reveals a substantial incompatibility between the wall-clock times in Table 3 and Table 4 for the same Humanoid U-Maze runs, exposing unreliable data. This matches the ground truth's identification that the wall-clock numbers (Table 4) are artificially manipulated to understate cost.

Finding 7 captures the overstatement that qualitatively better, skill-acquiring behaviors emerge, which the ground truth criticizes as overgeneralized based on anecdotical, unstable humanoid visualizations. The same lack-of-evidence issue is identified.
